fixes.fix: Defining module's globals (e.g. a module-level _config/_compat) shadowed names the generated __init__/__repr__ rely on; module globals now lowest priority and snippet globals merged in reverse
fixes.why: A user module with an ordinary global named _config makes attrs-generated __init__ crash or misbehave, purely due to name collision.

fixes.fix: __replace__ was built by passing the public evolve to _add_method_dunders, which mutated evolve's __qualname__/__module__/__doc__; now wraps evolve in a fresh function
fixes.why: Every class creation on 3.13+ clobbered metadata of the public attrs.evolve (breaks docs/pickling by name).
fixes.upstream_commit: f53fc54 Stop evolve dunders from being modified (#1606)

fixes.fix: define(...) decorator rebound nonlocal frozen/on_setattr, so reusing one decorator object leaked NO_OP or default on_setattr into later classes
fixes.why: Reusing dec = define(...) on several classes silently disabled validation on setattr or raised spurious on_setattr errors depending on order.

fixes.fix: optional([list of validators]) produced an _AndValidator holding a list, making the validator and its Attribute unhashable; compare/hash validators as tuple
fixes.why: Documented list form of optional() made hash(Attribute) raise TypeError, breaking e.g. filters.include/exclude on that field.

fixes.fix: Base class with private (name-mangled) __slots__ entries crashed slotted attrs subclass creation; names are now mangled before lookup
fixes.why: @define on a subclass of a plain class with __slots__ = ('__p',) raised AttributeError at class creation.

fixes.fix: Base class with string __slots__ = 'ab' was iterated per character; now treated as one slot
fixes.why: Valid Python string __slots__ in a base crashed slotted attrs subclass creation with AttributeError.

fixes.fix: Slotted __getstate__ crashed on attributes never set (init=False without default); unset names are now omitted
fixes.why: pickle/copy.copy of a valid slotted instance raised AttributeError while dict classes work; setstate already tolerates missing names.

fixes.fix: make_class popped hook methods (__attrs_post_init__ etc.) out of the caller's dict; now copies it
fixes.why: Mutating the caller's input dict meant reusing it for a second class silently lost the hooks.

fixes.fix: Converter wrote the return annotation into the wrapped converter's __annotations__ when it used the converter directly, crashing for functools.partial and mutating a callable instance's class annotations
fixes.why: Converter(partial(f), takes_self=True, takes_field=True) with an annotated f raised AttributeError, and callable instances had their class __annotations__ polluted.

fixes.fix: asdict with retain_collection_types=True crashed on namedtuples nested inside collections; falls back to cf(*items) for tuple subclasses
fixes.why: attrs.asdict (retain default True) raised TypeError for a list of namedtuples, while top-level namedtuple fields already had this workaround.

fixes.fix: filters.include/exclude put Attributes in a frozenset, crashing for Attributes with unhashable defaults; falls back to a tuple
fixes.why: exclude(fields(C).x) raised TypeError when x had a dict default, a common pattern.

fixes.fix: cmp_using classes raised AttributeError when compared with non-cmp_using objects (even C(1) != 1 with default require_same_type); now returns NotImplemented
fixes.why: Equality with an unrelated object must not raise; note the fix also rejects duck-typed objects with a .value attribute under require_same_type=False, a minor narrowing.

fixes.fix: astuple with retain_collection_types=True rebuilt defaultdict by passing items as default_factory, crashing; now passes the original default_factory
fixes.why: astuple(retain_collection_types=True) on a defaultdict field raised TypeError: first argument must be callable or None.
